content: प्रतिमा {%m.%} <ab>Ved.</ab> A creator, maker. .{@-मा@} .²1 An image, a likeness, statue, figure, an idol; पुरः परार्ध्यप्रतिमागृहायाः <ls>R. 16. 39</ls>. .²2 Resemblance, similitude; <ab>oft.</ab> in <ab>comp.</ab> in the sense of ‘like, similar, or equal to’; देवप्रतिम, अप्रतिम <ab>&c.</ab>; गुरोः कुशानुप्रतिमात् <ls>R. 2. 49</ls>; पतत्पतङ्गप्रतिमस्तपोनिधिः <ls>Śi. 1. 12</ls>. .²3 A reflection, reflected image; मुखमिन्दुरुज्ज्वलकपोलमतः प्रतिमाच्छलेन सुदृशामविशत् <ls>Śi. 9. 48</ls>, <ls n="Śi. 9.">73</ls>; <ls>R. 7. 64</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 100</ls>. .²4 A measure, extent. .²5 The part of an elephantʼs head between the tusks. .²6 A symbol.
